_comment: Files this submod ships at the same path as a Millennium Dawn file (so they replace MD's copy). 'merge': MD's file plus our edits, kept up to date with a 3-way merge against base/. 'replace': deliberate replacement of MD's Turkey content; MD changes are only reported for review. See tools/md_sync.py.

common/scripted_localisation/00_MD_polit.why: Turkey party names inserted at the top of each party defined_text (first match wins); MD's own TUR lines removed.

common/national_focus/01_EU_USoE_shared..why: Turkey-specific position offsets for the shared EU/USoE tree in each Turkish path.

common/countries/cosmetic.txt.why: Colours for the submod's cosmetic tags appended to MD's list (the game only reads this file name).

common/bookmarks/blitzkrieg.txt.why: Turkey's ideas and focuses shown on the bookmark screen.

history/countries/TUR - Turkey.txt.why: Turkey's start rebuilt on MD 2.0 history plus the submod's parties, characters and flags.

common/national_focus/turkey.txt.why: Intentionally empty: disables MD's Turkey focus tree so the submod's trees are used.

localisation/english/MD_focus_TUR_l_engl.why: Localisation for the submod's trees under MD's file name (MD's tree is disabled).

common/ai_strategy_plans/TUR_strategy_pl.why: MD's Turkey AI plans target MD's Turkey tree, which the submod disables.

common/on_actions/99_TUR_on_actions.txt.why: Submod's Turkish on_actions (daily/weekly mechanics, event dispatcher).

interface/theatreselector.gfx.why: noOfFrames 100 -> 115 for the army shield atlases and 31 -> 46 for the navy (task force) atlases, which carry 15 Turkish insignia after MD's frames.

gfx/army_icons/army_icons.txt.why: 15 Turkish insignia (original_tag = TUR) appended to MD's army list (frames 101-115) and to the fleet and task force lists (frames 32-46).
